description: Vaettiheim is a land of bitter winters and cool summers. It is the home of the Vaettir, small and wicked goblins who once dwelled in the icy forests of Jotunheim. When the Jarls of Jotunheim sealed the alliance with humankind the remaining Gygjas and their Vaetti servants retreated to the wild woods. With the guidance of the few remaining Gygjas the Vaettir formed a nation of their own. Vaettiheim is a land of Vaettir and giants centered at the Iron Wood, the ancient home of the Jotun Gygjas. With the coming of the Awakening God the Vaetti Hags of earlier times have been more or less replaced by Vaetti Gygjas trained in the Iron Wood and the Vaettir have adopted the weapons and armaments used by Jotuns and humans.
